inputs.name: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit: lroc_color_poles_2k.tif
inputs.notes: page https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720; credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio. The kit says it is optimized for aesthetics, not science.

inputs.name: NASA SVS CGI Moon Kit: ldem_16_uint.tif
inputs.notes: 5760x2880, 16 px/deg, half-metre DN; hillshade az 315 (from north) alt 45 z x3, multiplied into the colour map. Layout check: elevation vs albedo r = 0.33 (shifted 180 deg: -0.44); vs LOLA LDEM_256 windows r >= 0.98.

pixel_layout: row 0 = lat 90 (top), col 0 = lon -180 (left); pixel centres at half-pixel offsets

shading.az_reference: clockwise from north (map up). Cartographic light, not a real Sun position.

credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio, CGI Moon Kit (svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720)
notes: Visual background only; no metric uses it.
